import pandas as pd
import io
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and clean plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Create a bubble chart to visualize three dimensions: time (x), amount (y/size), and type (color)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size='amount',
    sizes=(150, 1500),  # Control the min and max size of the bubbles
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=ax
)

# --- Enhance the plot for maximum clarity and impact ---

# Set a clear and descriptive title and labels
ax.set_title('Transaction Analysis: Amount by Hour and Type', fontsize=18, weight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of Day (24-hour clock)', fontsize=14, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=14, labelpad=10)

# Format the y-axis to display as currency
formatter = mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.2f')
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)

# Set x-axis limits and ticks for better readability
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 2))
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)

# Improve and reposition the legend to avoid overlapping with data
ax.legend(title='Transaction Details', bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 1), loc='upper left')

# Add a subtle grid for better value tracking
ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Ensure the layout is tight and all elements are visible
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the generated plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')

# Close the plot to free up memory
plt.close(fig)
